Date: Apr 25, 2026 - May 4, 2026
* 🔴 User's Asheville, NC home renovation budget is $28,000. User prefers quartz countertops and matte black cabinet hardware.
* ✅ QuickRaze selected for demolition ($1,850).
* ✅ Electrical permit submitted for island outlets (electrician: Dale Okonkwo; 20-amp dedicated circuit).
* ✅ Harbor Plumbing booked for fixture installation (May 5–7 window); Carlos Ramos booked for faucet installation on May 15.
* ✅ GranitePeak “Arctic White” quartz countertop ordered (delivery May 7); later supplemented by “Storm Cloud” quartz ($78/sq ft). FaucetPro “AquaFlow-2000” faucet selected ($210).
* ✅ Cabinetry Creations cabinets, CabinetCo pull-out pantry ($1,150), and LED under-cabinet lighting configured.

Date: May 8, 2026 - May 12, 2026
* 🔴 (May 8, 16:00) User inquired about site delivery of the countertop sample prior to the site visit.
* 🔴 (May 12, 13:15) User reviewed CabinetCraft warranty coverage (10-year structural, 2-year finish).
* ✅ (May 8, 09:50) “Storm Cloud” quartz countertop option added to budget.
* ✅ (May 8, 15:15) Plumber Carlos Ramos booked for faucet installation on May 15.
* ✅ (May 12, 09:45) Ordered 450 sq ft of matte ivory porcelain tiles from TileMasters (shipping May 20–22).
* ✅ (May 12, 16:40) CabinetCraft walnut island cabinets ($4,200) added to budget; installation scheduled for the week of May 25.
</observations>
